speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing a longstanding pruritic rash along with numbness and tingling in your palms. To understand the underlying cause, have you noticed any specific triggers for the rash, such as contact with certain materials or changes in your environment?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT). The combination of pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body), sensory neuropathy in the hands, and exposure to livestock (likely due to hemochromatosis or liver stress) is highly characteristic. I would like to confirm if you have noticed blisters or scarring on your skin after minor sun exposure.
